name: diplomatic relation towards
description: Official diplomatic stance of FROM towards TO: -100 = hostile, relations broken off, 0 = neutral or no meaningful relations, 100 = closest allies.

name: social view towards
description: How the population of FROM views TO: -100 = hatred, 0 = indifference, 100 = strong sympathy.

name: perceived subordination towards
description: How dependent FROM believes it is on TO (politically, militarily, economically): 0 = not at all, 50 = clearly constrained by TO, 100 = FROM sees itself as TO's vassal. The reverse dependence is the pair TO->FROM.

name: perceived power towards
description: How strongly FROM believes it can influence TO (economically, politically, militarily): 0 = no influence, 50 = noticeable influence, 100 = decisive influence.

name: real subordination towards
description: Actual POLITICAL AND MILITARY dependence of FROM on TO (economy is in 'economic dependence'), as judged by an outside observer: 0 = none, 50 = TO can clearly constrain FROM's foreign/security policy, 100 = FROM is TO's satellite.

name: real power towards
description: Actual ability of FROM to influence TO (economically, politically, militarily), as judged by an outside observer: 0 = none, 50 = noticeable, 100 = decisive. Not symmetric (FROM->TO differs from TO->FROM).

name: economic dependence
description: How much the economy of FROM depends on TO (trade, energy, finance, remittances): 0 = none, 50 = a crisis in TO clearly hurts FROM, 100 = FROM's economy cannot function without TO. Drives how crises spread in the engine's second (external) turn.

name: hybrid attacks towards
description: 1 = FROM conducted sustained hostile actions below open war against TO at any time during the year (sabotage, major cyberattacks, disinformation campaigns, weaponised migration), e.g. Belarus->Poland 2021.
